description: Get the reverse-split LIFECYCLE Signal8 has tracked from a company's own SEC filings (proxies, 8-K Items 3.03/5.03/5.07, 6-Ks): one episode per split authority, newest first, each with its state (proposed, vote scheduled, approved, ratio set, effective date announced, charter filed, … or closed), the ratio or authorised range, meeting / vote / effective dates, the state history, and the events behind it oldest first. Every event carries its source (accession and an EDGAR sourceUrl) and its facts; every STATED fact carries the VERBATIM QUOTE it was read from — cite the quote and link the source rather than paraphrasing. 🔴 NOT STATED IS NOT MEASURED, NEVER "NO". A fact with notStated:true (or a null field) means the documents read did not say it — never that it is false, zero or absent. coverage "unresolved" means the ticker could not be matched to an SEC registrant: NOT MEASURED. coverage "tracked" with an EMPTY episodes list means no episode has been tracked from the filings read since the tracker started — it is NOT evidence that no reverse split is planned; never say "no reverse split". effectiveDate is the date the ISSUER STATED, strictly parsed: a SCHEDULED date, not a confirmation that the split happened (it can be postponed or abandoned). A conditional date ("the 25th trading day after the Trigger Event") is returned VERBATIM in effectiveCondition and is never a date — do not compute one from it. verification is copied from the tracker: "provisional" = one source, not cross-checked (the default, not "doubtful"); "verified" = cross-checked. An HTTP 503 FEATURE_DISABLED means the lifecycle tracker is switched off: report that it is unavailable and say nothing about the company's splits.
name: get_reverse_split_lifecycle
title: Get Reverse Split Lifecycle
